technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with ADX confirmation and price above all key MAs, but extreme overbought conditions across all momentum oscillators and declining volume create elevated pullback risk; better suited for scaling into weakness than aggressive entry.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 26 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear state (40 VIX equivalent) with neutral AAII sentiment and no recent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (400.48) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event creates severe macro headwinds; 26-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong uptrend structure with ADX confirmation and price above all major moving averages provides directional conviction for continuation.
